name: lowlatency_92BVL_DSA_A2_W8A8C16_3P4_1D4_test3
description: A2 92B VL low latency: 3 x TP4 prefill + 1 x TP1/DP4 decode; P/D max-num-seqs 16/16, MTP3, decode graph tokens 4/8/16/32/64; aligned with openpangu_v2_92B_VL_a2_server_template_for_3P4_1D4_low_latency.yml

unit_configs.cmd:
set -e
: "${MODEL_PATH:?MODEL_PATH is required}" "${POD_IP:?ModelArts must provide POD_IP}"
export CODE_PATH="${CODE_PATH:-/workspace/omniinfer}"
SCRIPT_PATH="${CODE_PATH}/tools/deploy/model_arts"
ALL_IPS=$(python3 "${SCRIPT_PATH}/get_node_ip_list.py")
DECODE_IP=$(python3 -c 'import sys
role, all_ips, pod_ip = sys.argv[1:]
groups = all_ips.split(";")
if len(groups) != 4 or any(not ip or "," in ip for ip in groups) or len(set(groups)) != 4:
    sys.exit("Expected four distinct single-pod MA groups in P0;P1;P2;D0 order: " + all_ips)
if pod_ip not in (groups[:3] if role == "prefill" else groups[3:]):
    sys.exit("POD_IP does not match the " + role + " groups: " + pod_ip)
print(groups[3])' prefill "$ALL_IPS" "$POD_IP")
for env_script in /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/vendors/omni_custom_ops/bin/set_env.bash /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/vendors/omni_training_custom_ops/bin/set_env.bash; do
  if [ -f "$env_script" ]; then
    . "$env_script"
  fi
done
MEDIA_IO_KWARGS=$(python3 -c 'import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
path = Path(os.environ["MODEL_PATH"]) / "preprocessor_config.json"
data = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
print(json.dumps({"image":{"rgba_background_color":[128,128,128]},"video":{"num_frames":data.get("num_frames",32),"sample_fps":data.get("sample_fps",1)}},separators=(",", ":")))')
TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 bash "${SCRIPT_PATH}/proxy.sh" \
  --log-level notice \
  --core-num 4 \
  --start-core-index 16 \
  --client-max-body-size 1000M \
  --client-body-buffer-size 50M \
  --omni-proxy-pd-policy sequential \
  --omni-proxy-max-batch-num-token 100000 \
  --omni-proxy-prefill-max-num-seqs 16 \
  --omni-proxy-decode-max-num-seqs 16
MM_FEATURE_TRANSFER_CONFIG="{\"connector_type\":\"NetworkMMFeatureConnector\",\"remote_endpoints\":[\"tcp://${DECODE_IP}:5555\"],\"exclude_fields\":\"\"}"
bash "${SCRIPT_PATH}/prefill.sh" \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --block-size 128 \
  --additional-config '{"enable_low_latency":true,"npugraph_ex_config":{"enable":true,"super_kernel_optimize":false,"static_kernel_compile":true}}' \
  --speculative_config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' \
  --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --trust-request-chat-template \
  --hf-overrides '{"model_architectures":"OpenPanguV2ForCausalLM","text_config":{"model_architectures":"OpenPanguV2ForCausalLM"}}' \
  --allowed-local-media-path / \
  --media-io-kwargs "$MEDIA_IO_KWARGS" \
  --mm-processor-kwargs '{"image_use_fast":true}' \
  --mm-processor-cache-gb 8 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --enforce-eager \
  --mm-processor-cache-type shm \
  --mm-shm-cache-max-object-size-mb 256 \
  --mm-feature-transfer-config "$MM_FEATURE_TRANSFER_CONFIG"
exec sleep infinity
unit_configs.name: prefill-0
